banking-economy.title: Govt keeps PSB employees' PLI scheme for FY26 in abeyance after union representation
banking-economy.summary: The government has postponed the performance-linked incentive scheme for bank employees. This decision follows employee representations seeking a review of the existing structure. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman met with bank employee representatives to discuss their concerns. The scheme's implementation for 2025-26 will be kept in abeyance. Discussions will continue through bipartite settlement and joint note talks.
